description: Research fork of Espressif's esp-tflite-micro used for the book chapter "Same Model, Different Robot: Checking Int8 Runtimes Before the Robot Moves". It contains benchmark, long-run and operator-trace instrumentation for the person_detection example on an ESP32-D0WD-V3, a boot-time acceptance-test firmware, a row-following policy (W2) with its hardware-in-the-loop harness, Arm Cortex-M and x86 build scripts, the code-layout (IRAM) and skip-nudge requantization experiments, the raw serial logs and the figure scripts. Built with ESP-IDF v6.0.3 and ESP-NN 1.4.1.
